businessQuestion: What is our total revenue leakage and reimbursement performance over the last 3 years?
sqlAnswer:
SELECT
    SUM(revenue_leakage_amount) AS total_revenue_leakage,
    SUM(reimbursement_amount) AS total_reimbursement,
    ROUND(
        (SUM(reimbursement_amount) / SUM(revenue_leakage_amount)) * 100,
        2
    ) AS reimbursement_performance_percentage
FROM claims
WHERE claim_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '3 years';
